# 7-Zip

This directory contains the official 64-bit 7-Zip 24.09 command-line extractor:

- `7z.exe`
- `7z.dll`

Author: Igor Pavlov  
Official site: https://www.7-zip.org/  
Version: 24.09

The launcher uses these files only to inspect and extract a `.7z` archive that
the user selects locally. See `LICENSE.txt` for the upstream licensing terms.
